cases.name: Cortny R. Huffman
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She graduated from Hamilton High School and studied teaching at East Central College in St. Clair, Mo. Cortny had worked at Kids International Early Childhood Education in St. Louis. She loved spending time with her friends and family, especially her daughters."
